verdicts.reason: A swaps the words so it reads 'MAKEUP TRAVEL KIT'. It also leaves a huge dead gap between the side-by-side pair and a far larger KIT box, and both share a visible pale seam band across the middle of the background. B keeps the correct TRAVEL/MAKEUP/KIT order with consistent box widths. But its three small labels are spread far apart, so the headline breaks into fragments and the title feels undersized. It has the same seamed background band, and most of the makeup imagery is lost.
